**Overlap with the 10 most volatile sessions?**

**No overlap.** None of the 10 highest-volume sessions appear in the top-10 realized-volatility list (and vice versa).

- **Highest-volume sessions** are dominated by mega-cap, highly liquid names: **NVDA (4×), INTC (4×), WMT, NFLX**.
- **Highest-volatility sessions** are all in smaller, less liquid names: **ALIT, AAOI, CORT, ASST (2×), CCOI, AEVA, AVAV, CRML, BHVN** — with realized volatilities of **13–25%**, far above the 1.7–3.9% seen in the high-volume sessions.

This separation reflects the typical market structure: the most liquid large caps trade enormous share counts but with relatively calm minute-to-minute price action, while the most volatile intraday moves occur in less liquid names where modest volume can produce large percentage swings.
